reason: A DSH LLM adapter that reuses Codex CLI credentials to connect to ChatGPT subscription models through ChatGPT or OpenAI Responses API endpoints; credential access and optional write-back warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 通过复用 Codex CLI 的本地登录凭证，将 ChatGPT 订阅模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并支持流式文本响应。
summaries.en: Connects ChatGPT subscription models to DeepSeek Harness by reusing local Codex CLI credentials and supporting streamed text responses.

capabilities: reads local Codex CLI authentication data
refreshes OAuth tokens and may write updated credentials back to the local auth file
sends chat requests to ChatGPT or OpenAI endpoints
streams text, reasoning, usage, and tool-call responses
